facts.fact: In Addis Ababa connectivity has been created from the central level down to the woreda level as a major pilot for civil registration and citizenship services, on the account of the deputy director general of the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute; the document gives no date, so its published date is used.
facts.system: Addis Ababa central-to-woreda connectivity for civil registration and resident services

facts.fact: Over the Addis Ababa central-to-woreda connectivity, family registration, vital events registration, resident services and verification are carried out through a digital system built with locally developed applications, a government statement says; no date given, published date used.
facts.system: Addis Ababa central-to-woreda connectivity for civil registration and resident services

facts.fact: The central-to-woreda connectivity is described as a major pilot effort in Addis Ababa only; no count of woredas connected and no total is given, and no date, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Addis Ababa central-to-woreda connectivity for civil registration and resident services

systems.system: Addis Ababa civil registration and resident services digital system
systems.country_label: family registration, vital events registration, resident services and verification
systems.tiers: Addis Ababa: central level down to woreda level

note: The whole document is one paragraph. It concerns the capital city only; woredas here are Addis Ababa's own. Who owns or pays for the connectivity is not stated.
